description: Add a route with full control over match conditions and handlers. Supports any Caddy handler (reverse_proxy, file_server, static_response, redirect, encode, headers, etc.).

handle.description: Array of handler objects (e.g., [{ handler: 'file_server', root: '/var/www' }])

match.description: Array of match objects (e.g., [{ host: ['example.com'], path: ['/api/*'] }])

terminal.description: Stop processing further routes after this one matches

name: caddy_add_route
